# delete_user_history()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.delete_user_history`

## Signature

```python
async def delete_user_history(chat_id: Union[int, str], user_id: Union[int, str]) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Delete all messages sent by a certain user in a supergroup.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`chat_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the target chat.
  You can also use chat public link in form of *t.me/<username>* (str).

- **`user_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the user whose messages will be deleted.
  You can also use user profile link in form of *t.me/<username>* (str).

### Returns

`bool`: True on success, False otherwise.
